items.title: Pearl Abyss boosts Crimson Desert game discoverability with Amazon GameLift Streams Instant Play Demos
items.summary: For video game marketers, few things are more persuasive than putting a game directly into players’ hands. Trailers, screenshots, and cinematic reveals build anticipation, but only playing the game lets fans experience it for themselves before purchasing. Historically, players had to download game demos that were often restricted to certain platforms to trial a game. […]
